kms.tf:
# Deployment key is implemented by the child module.
module "zic_deployment_cmk" {
  source = "../../components/terraform/zic-deployment-cmk"
  deployment_account_id  = "123456789012"
  zic_role_arn           = data.aws_iam_role.zic.arn
  key_description        = "This is a KMS key for ZIC deployment"
  key_alias              = "alias/zic-deployment-key"
  key_administrator_arns = ["arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/admin"]
  key_user_arns          = ["arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/user"]
  grant_account_ids      = ["123456789012"]
  tags                   = { "Name" = "ZIC Deployment Key", "Environment" = "Production" }
}
